description: Lists published items of EOL Watch: retirements, end of support dates and breaking changes. Filter by cloud, kind of change, category, service, search text and effective date. Without status it lists upcoming items only, soonest first. To list ended items, breaking changes in effect or every item, send status ended, in_effect or all. Use it for questions such as what retires in the next 90 days or what is due for one service. It returns one page of compact rows as a Markdown table and as structured data, with the UTC day the countdowns were counted for (as_of). Call get_item for the full text of one item. This tool does not check an estate: that check runs in the reader's browser only.

category.description: Category group, as in the address of a category page.

cloud.description: Clouds to include. Leave it out for every cloud.

dir.description: asc (the default) or desc. The added order ignores it.

from.description: Earliest effective_date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). An item without a date never matches. A month, quarter or year is compared by its first day; use within_days for what is due or what ended.

limit.description: Most items in one answer: 1 to 100, 25 by default.

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip. Send the next_offset of an answer to get the next page.

q.description: Search text of at most 100 characters. Every word must occur in the title, the summary, the service, the slug or an affected version.

service.description: Service slug of at most 80 characters, as in the service_slug field. Two clouds can use the same slug, so send cloud with it.

sort.description: date (the default): by effective_date, items without a date last; a list of ended items or of changes in effect (status=ended, status=in_effect) is ordered by the last day of each effective period. added: newest first by created_at, then by the later announcement date (items without one last), then by the soonest effective date, then by title. service: by service name.

status.description: upcoming (the default): items whose effective period is not over, including items without a date. ended: retirements and end of support dates whose whole period is over. in_effect: breaking changes whose date has passed (a breaking change takes effect, it does not end, so it is never in ended). all: every item.

to.description: Latest effective_date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). An item without a date never matches. A month, quarter or year is compared by its first day; use within_days for what is due or what ended.

type.description: Kinds of change to include. Leave it out for every kind.

within_days.description: Only items at most this many days from the as_of day (1 to 3650). With status upcoming: items due in the next N days, including an item whose month, quarter or year has started and is not over. With status ended or in_effect: items that ended or took effect in the last N days. With status all: all of these. Cannot be combined with from or to.

name: search_items

as_of.description: The UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) every value that depends on the day was counted for.

count.description: Number of items in this answer.

generated_at.description: Moment this answer was built (ISO 8601, UTC).

items.description: The items of this page, as compact rows. Call get_item with the slug of a row for its full record.

announced_date.description: Date the vendor announced the change (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not stated.

category.description: Kind of thing affected, for example service, runtime, kubernetes or database.

cloud.description: Cloud or product group the item belongs to: azure, aws, gcp, oci, m365, github or multi.

days.description: Calendar days from the as_of day to the first day of the effective period. Zero or negative once that day has come. Null when there is no date. A month, quarter or year is over only after its last day, so read state to know whether an item has ended or is in effect. For an item dated by month, quarter or year that has ended, this is not the number of days since it ended: the pages count those from the last day of the period.

effective_date.description: Date the change takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not announced. For month, quarter and year precision this is the first day of the period.

effective_precision.description: How exact effective_date is: day, month, quarter or year.

service.description: Display name of the affected service.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the item. Never changes once published.

source_url.description: Page the item was verified against: an official vendor page, or the endoflife.date page for the few products where it is the only source of the date.

state.description: Where the item stands on the as_of day: upcoming (its effective period is not over), ended (a retirement or an end of support whose whole period is over), in_effect (a breaking change whose date has passed: it took effect, it does not end) or no_date (no date is announced).

title.description: Short headline of the lifecycle change.

type.description: Kind of change: retirement, end_of_support or breaking_change.

url.description: Page for this item on the site.

name.description: Name of the license, or the words that say none is chosen yet.

note.description: What that means for reuse of the data.

url.description: Address of the license text, or null when there is none.

limit.description: Most items one answer holds for this query.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or null when this answer holds the last match.

next_url.description: Address of the next page of this list, at the data address, or null when this answer holds the last match.

offset.description: Number of matching items skipped before the first of this answer.

query.description: The query as it was understood: every parameter with the value that was used.

category.description: Category group asked for, or null.

cloud.description: Clouds asked for. Empty: every cloud.

from.description: Earliest effective_date asked for, or null.

q.description: Search text as it was used, or null.

service.description: Service slug asked for, or null.

status.description: Which items by state: upcoming, ended, in_effect or all.

to.description: Latest effective_date asked for, or null.

type.description: Kinds of change asked for. Empty: every kind.

within_days.description: Number of days from the as_of day asked for, or null.

site.description: The site the data comes from.

status_counts.description: Number of items the query matches in each status, with every other parameter as it was used. An empty list of upcoming items can stand next to items that have ended or are in effect: send status=all to list them.

ended.description: Items it matches with status ended.

in_effect.description: Items it matches with status in_effect.

upcoming.description: Items it matches with status upcoming.

total.description: Number of items that match the query.

title: Search items
